nonhead_order_exists.meaning: a non-head order exists in a price level's doubly linked list
nonhead_order_exists.checkpoint: before removal of the non-head order

append_updates_links.meaning: a new order is appended to the price level with both forward and back links updated
append_updates_links.checkpoint: before removal of the non-head order

removed_order_is_head.meaning: the removal routine treats the removed non-head order as the head of the price level
removed_order_is_head.checkpoint: during removal of the non-head order

head_moved_past_real_head.meaning: limit.headOrder is moved past the real head, orphaning earlier orders
head_moved_past_real_head.checkpoint: after removal of the non-head order

orders_addressable_via_chain.meaning: every order remains addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain
orders_addressable_via_chain.checkpoint: after removal of the non-head order

assumptions: The corruption persists because every operation is wrapped in a successful transaction.
The removal routine is invoked on a non-head order in a price level whose head is a different order.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of the headOrder/tailOrder chain linkage (prevOrderId/nextOrderId values), so addressability is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a link-value equality.

limitations: Only the head-moved-past-real-head impact is formalized; orphaned-order invisibility, sentinel best-price, and open-interest misstatement are handled in separate passes.
No authorization or caller qualifier is supported by the report, so the condition is limited to the structural non-head-order scenario.
